ruleDefinitions.name: T1204.004 — ClickFix Paste-and-Run (Fact #19)
ruleDefinitions.description: ClickFix Paste-and-Run. Trigger: PowerShell connects outbound to a non-standard high port immediately after spawning
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: PowerShell connected to {dest_host}:{dest_port}, a port commonly associated with C2 frameworks
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
